parole.significato: provisions (food e.g. for a picnic or journey)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *eväs, possibly borrowed from Indo-Iranian (see the Proto-Finnic entry for more). Related to Ingrian eväs and Karelian eväs.

parole.significato: thick (relatively great in extent from one surface to the opposite in its smallest solid dimension)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *paksu (compare Estonian paks), possibly borrowed from Indo-Iranian (compare Sanskrit बहु (bahu, “much, many, abundant”)), from Proto-Indo-European *bʰn̥ǵʰús (“thick”); see the Proto-Finnic entry for more.
From Proto-Finnic *përna (compare Estonian põrn (“spleen”)), possibly from Indo-Iranian.

parole.significato: to give, allow, permit, grant, let, afford (generally from someone of higher status to someone of lower status)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *soodak (possibly borrowed from Indo-Iranian; see entry for more).

parole.significato: great fen-sedge, saw-sedge, swamp sawgrass (Cladium mariscus)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *tarna, ultimately a borrowing from Indo-Iranian (and a distant cognate with English thorn).

parole.significato: healthy, sane (enjoying health and vigor of body, mind, or spirit)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *terveh, with a root probably borrowed from Indo-Iranian (compare Avestan 𐬛𐬆𐬭𐬆𐬎𐬎𐬁 (dərəuuā, “healthy”)).
